assertions: Mature external investment models are registered with explicit applicability and invalidation conditions rather than reimplemented as a local doctrine.
CORE, MATURE_CONDITIONAL, CONTESTED_CONDITIONAL, and STATE_MODEL standings are mechanically distinct.
Contested models route to research-only by default.
The read-only circuit derives risk-budget standing from owner authority rather than caller tags.
An UNSET owner risk budget blocks sizing proposals.
Liquidity or funding stress and explicit model conflict prevent sizing escalation.
Decision support does not mint provider permission, trade approval, order generation, or external financial write authority.
